decisions.decision: Core-owned geometry shared by UI and export.

decisions.decision: Native editable color recipes plus portable derived color fonts.

decisions.decision: Single writer and revision-checked transactions per document.
decisions.basis: Prevent automation and manual edits from silently overwriting one another.

decisions.basis: M0 validates portable contracts, reference integrity and integer dimension bounds without network or Inputs.

decisions.decision: Chart-specific symbol IDs stay stable when their names or transliterations change.

decisions.decision: Strict explicit source codecs; preserve bytes, scalars and unknown slots.
decisions.basis: Legacy import cannot silently normalize, replace or guess characters.

decisions.decision: Python evidence tooling with pinned dependencies; no editor runtime is implied.
